item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 26/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The upper-air disturbances now affecting the coast of southern China will depart from the region tomorrow. Besides, the northeast monsoon will be replaced by a maritime airstream gradually in the next couple of days, temperatures will rise progressively over the coast of Guangdong. There may be damp days over the weekend. The weather will be humid and foggy in the morning and at night. It will be warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across southern China on Tuesday. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, temperatures will fall progressively over the region in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be cooler appreciably with rain.
